column1: # The shape rules' own proof, one case per line: rule, expectation, text.
# "catches" means the rule must match this text, or it would report zero occurrences for content it
# is written to find. "ignores" means it must not: a rule that fires on a function at the limit rather
# than over it, on a name that is called, or on a method reached through an interface is noise, and
# noise is how a check like this gets switched off.
# A case is tried as Go source, and a `// path: <file> ` header names the file it is read as. A case
# is one line, so a newline inside it is written `\n` and a tab `\t`.
